'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Andrew Moss LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Moss]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck '''Boom! Numero Deux'''. Typed sheet. Shield 12 blank (11 shields). Additional cards: Jabba's Prize (V) not counted in 60. Line 40 '''Speak With The Jedi (V)''' as written; line 41 sheet '''Your Insights Serve You Well'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Wend
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
